thread:
Tanya Morales: opened PR to add an "HSM audit forwarding" appendix to the private installer docs. goal: show rsyslog/journal forwarding examples, preserved timestamps, and minimal ACL notes for syslog receivers. https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/4953

Luca Bianchi: great. ops often ask how to forward HSM logs from air-gapped clusters to a central SIEM via a bastion. can we show a secure rsyslog relay + TLS config and a tiny tcpwrap firewall hint?

Tanya Morales: added a TLS-forwarding rsyslog snippet (cert+key paths) and a note about setting ProtectSystem in systemd for rsyslog to reduce attack surface. snippet:```conf
# /etc/rsyslog.d/90-hsm-forward.conf
module(load="imuxsock")
module(load="omfwd")
action(type="omfwd" target="siem.example.internal" port="6514" protocol="tcp" StreamDriver="gtls" StreamDriverMode="1" StreamDriverAuthMode="x509" StreamDriverPermittedPeers="siem.example.internal")
```

Mina Patel: also include journald forwarding option (systemd-journal-remote) for customers that prefer binary journald transport. short enable+socket example?

Tanya Morales: added quick steps: `systemctl enable --now systemd-journal-remote.socket` and a note to set ForwardToSyslog=yes in journald.conf so rsyslog can pick it up locally.

Luca Bianchi: ops wanted preserved HSM timestamping and timezone handling advice. add that journals preserve monotonic boot time; recommend using RFC3339 timestamps at the receiver and avoid local-time conversions in pipeline.

Tanya Morales: added paragraph: "At ingestion, convert to UTC and store original timezone in a field to avoid ambiguity during audits." also included a short rsyslog template example.

Mina Patel: add minimal firewall hint: allow 6514 only from bastion IPs and use iptables/nftables one-liner.

Tanya Morales: added one-liners: `iptables -A OUTPUT -p tcp -d 10.30.0.10 --dport 6514 -j ACCEPT` and `nft add rule ip filter output tcp dport 6514 ip daddr 10.30.0.10 accept`.

docs-link-bot: ERROR: PR 4953 - broken internal link to /private/audit/hsm-forwarding. Suggested path /private/vpc/audit-forwarding.

Tanya Morales: good catch. updated cross-links and added a redirect note. also added an Elixir SDK snippet for local sidecar testing per support request (minimal).

```elixir
# mix.exs deps: {:redwood, "~> 0.1"}
client = Redwood.Client.new(api_key: "REDACTED", base_url: "http://127.0.0.1:8080")
{:ok, resp} = Redwood.Client.generate(client, "ping")
IO.puts(resp.text)
```

Mina Patel: LGTM, just add a WARN: do not forward raw PKCS#11 output or private keys in logs. redact sensitive tokens before sending to SIEM.

Tanya Morales: WARN added. merging after docs CI. will monitor support for any follow-ups. :shipit:
